actions.script: def zinr = context.zinr def colorMap = [cash:'success', upi:'primary', card:'info', 'net banking':'teal', wallet:'warning', credit:'danger'] def iconMap = [cash:'payments', upi:'qr_code_2', card:'credit_card', 'net banking':'account_balance', wallet:'account_balance_wallet', credit:'credit_card'] def paymentReport=ec.service.sync().name('zenith.pos.PosServices.get#PosPaymentBreakdown').parameters([fromDate:dayStart,thruDate:dayEnd]).call() def all=paymentReport.rows ?: [] all.each { m -> def k=m.paymentMethod.toLowerCase();m.color=colorMap[k] ?: 'grey';m.icon=iconMap[k] ?: 'payment' m.amtStr=zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(m.totalAmount,'#,##0.00'));m.pctStr=ec.l10n.format(m.percentage,'#0.00')+'%' } def stx=(searchText ?: '').trim().toLowerCase() paymentWiseList=stx ? all.findAll { (it.paymentMethod ?: '').toLowerCase().contains(stx) } : all grandTotalAmount=paymentWiseList.inject(BigDecimal.ZERO){sum,m -> sum+m.totalAmount} grandTotalStr = '₹ ' + zinr.inr(ec.l10n.format(grandTotalAmount, '#,##0.00')) methodCount = paymentWiseList.size()

container.style: zenith-card bg-white shadow-2 border-radius-lg q-pa-md q-mb-md
